body_text: HPD’s rule exempts motels and tourist cabins from the replacement ratio requirement. Thus, if there was a motel or tourist cabin on the eligible site three years prior to the commencement date, the motel rooms or tourist cabins that were demolished, removed or reconfigured would not each have to be replaced with an affordable housing unit.  However, such eligible sites would still have to meet one of the affordability options under RPTL Section 421-a(16) (the six rental affordability options require between 25-30% affordable units ranging from 40% to 130% of Area Median Income) in order to qualify for this tax exemption benefit.
